 15class OutputEndCondition:
 16    """This type defines when end of an input stream should trigger end of the output stream. Only one of those fields can
 17    be set at the time.
 18    Unless specified otherwise the input stream is considered finished/ended when:
 19    - TCP connection was dropped/closed.
 20    - RTCP Goodbye packet (`BYE`) was received.
 21    - Mp4 track has ended.
 22    - Input was unregistered already (or never registered).
 23
 24        Attributes:
 25            any_of (list[str] | None | Unset): Terminate output stream if any of the input streams from the list are
 26                finished.
 27            all_of (list[str] | None | Unset): Terminate output stream if all the input streams from the list are finished.
 28            any_input (bool | None | Unset): Terminate output stream if any of the input streams ends. This includes streams
 29                added after the output was registered. In particular, output stream will **not be** terminated if no inputs were
 30                ever connected.
 31            all_inputs (bool | None | Unset): Terminate output stream if all the input streams finish. In particular, output
 32                stream will **be** terminated if no inputs were ever connected.
